```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(recipes)
library(uwot)
library(forcats)
library(beepr)
library(yardstick)
library(aqp)
# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) y else x
}

first_non_na <- function(x) {
  y <- x[!is.na(x) & str_squish(as.character(x)) != ""]
  if (length(y) == 0) NA_character_ else as.character(y[1])
}

mode_non_na <- function(x) {
  y <- x[!is.na(x) & str_squish(as.character(x)) != ""]
  if (length(y) == 0) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(y), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

parse_top_bottom <- function(x) {
  top <- as.numeric(str_extract(x, "^\\d+"))
  bot <- as.numeric(str_extract(x, "(?<=-)\\d+"))
  tibble(top_cm = top, bottom_cm = bot)
}

hz_base <- function(hz) {
  h <- str_to_upper(str_trim(hz %||% ""))
  h <- str_replace_all(h, "\\s+", "")
  h <- str_remove(h, "\\d+$")

  case_when(
    str_detect(h, "^AP")         ~ "Ap",
    str_detect(h, "^AB")         ~ "Ab",
    str_detect(h, "^AG")         ~ "Ag",
    str_detect(h, "^A")          ~ "A",
    str_detect(h, "^EG")         ~ "Eg",
    str_detect(h, "^EX")         ~ "Ex",
    str_detect(h, "^E")          ~ "E",
    str_detect(h, "^B[T].*G")    ~ "Btg",
    str_detect(h, "^B[T].*SS")   ~ "Btss",
    str_detect(h, "^B[T].*X")    ~ "Btx",
    str_detect(h, "^B[T]")       ~ "Bt",
    str_detect(h, "^BH")         ~ "Bh",
    str_detect(h, "^BC")         ~ "BC",
    str_detect(h, "^BX")         ~ "Bx",
    str_detect(h, "^B")          ~ "B",
    str_detect(h, "^CG")         ~ "Cg",
    str_detect(h, "^C")          ~ "C",
    str_detect(h, "^OA")         ~ "Oa",
    str_detect(h, "^OE")         ~ "Oe",
    str_detect(h, "^R")          ~ "R",
    TRUE                         ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

is_carbonate_hz <- function(hz) {
  h <- str_to_lower(str_trim(hz %||% ""))
  str_detect(h, "k")
}

is_gleyed <- function(hz, chroma) {
  h <- str_to_lower(str_trim(hz %||% ""))
  g_suffix <- str_detect(h, "g")
  low_chroma <- !is.na(chroma) & chroma <= 2
  g_suffix | low_chroma
}

hex_to_rgb01 <- function(hex_vec) {
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(hex_vec), ncol = 3)
  ok <- !is.na(hex_vec) & nzchar(hex_vec)

  if (any(ok)) {
    rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex_vec[ok])
    out[ok, ] <- t(rgb) / 255
  }

  out
}

# FIXES PERRY COLORS LIKE "10YR4/2" -> "10YR 4/2"
fix_munsell <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_replace("^([0-9.]+[A-Z]+)([0-9.]+/[0-9.]+)$", "\\1 \\2")
}

# SAFE weighted mean
wmean_or_na <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w)
  if (!any(ok)) NA_real_ else weighted.mean(x[ok], w[ok])
}

# SAFE min
min_or_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else min(x)
}

parse_subgrp_mods <- function(subgrp, gg_hint = NA_character_) {
  x0 <- subgrp %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    na_if("")

  if (is.na(x0)) {
    return(tibble(
      subgrp_gg = gg_hint %||% NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod1 = NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod2 = NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod3 = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  toks <- str_split(x0, "\\s+", simplify = FALSE)[[1]]
  toks <- toks[toks != ""]

  if (length(toks) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      subgrp_gg = gg_hint %||% NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod1 = NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod2 = NA_character_,
      taxsubgrp_mod3 = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  gg <- if (!is.na(gg_hint) && str_squish(gg_hint) != "") gg_hint else toks[length(toks)]
  mods <- if (length(toks) >= 2) toks[1:(length(toks) - 1)] else character(0)

  tibble(
    subgrp_gg      = gg,
    taxsubgrp_mod1 = mods[1] %||% NA_character_,
    taxsubgrp_mod2 = mods[2] %||% NA_character_,
    taxsubgrp_mod3 = mods[3] %||% NA_character_
  )
}

add_top1_margin <- function(pred_df) {
  pred_cols <- names(pred_df)[
    str_detect(names(pred_df), "^\\.pred_") & names(pred_df) != ".pred_class"
  ]

  pred_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      top1 = max(c_across(all_of(pred_cols))),
      top2 = ifelse(length(pred_cols) > 1,
                    sort(c_across(all_of(pred_cols)), decreasing = TRUE)[2],
                    NA_real_),
      margin = ifelse(length(pred_cols) > 1, top1 - top2, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

overlap_thick <- function(top, bot, a, b) {
  pmax(0, pmin(bot, b) - pmax(top, a))
}

wmean_safe <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(x[ok] * w[ok]) / sum(w[ok])
}

is_sandy_hz <- function(texcl, sand, clay,
                        sand_min = 70, clay_max = 15,
                        tex_fallback = c("Sand", "Loamy sand")) {

  primary <- is.finite(sand) & is.finite(clay) &
    (sand >= sand_min) & (clay <= clay_max)

  fallback <- (!is.finite(sand) | !is.finite(clay)) &
    !is.na(texcl) &
    (str_to_lower(texcl) %in% str_to_lower(tex_fallback))

  primary | fallback
}

calc_sandy_indices <- function(df, interval_top = 0, interval_bot = 150) {

  d <- df %>%
    mutate(
      hzdept = as.numeric(hzdept),
      hzdepb = as.numeric(hzdepb),
      hz_thick = hzdepb - hzdept,
      sand = as.numeric(sandtotmeasured),
      clay = as.numeric(claytotmeasured),
      sandy_hz = is_sandy_hz(texcl, sand, clay),
      bt_like = (!is.na(L_suffix) & str_detect(str_to_lower(L_suffix), "t")) |
        (!is.na(hzname_clean) & str_detect(hzname_clean, "^Bt")) |
        (!is.na(hzname) & str_detect(hzname, "^Bt"))
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(hzdept), is.finite(hzdepb), hzdepb > hzdept) %>%
    arrange(hzdept, hzdepb)

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      sandy_mantle_cm = NA_real_,
      depth_to_first_nonsandy_cm = NA_real_,
      sandy_layers_n_surface = NA_real_,
      pct_sandy_0_150 = NA_real_,
      mean_sand_0_150 = NA_real_,
      mean_clay_0_150 = NA_real_,
      has_bt_below_mantle = NA,
      delta_clay_at_mantle_break = NA_real_,
      delta_sand_at_mantle_break = NA_real_,
      abrupt_sand_to_bt_transition = NA
    ))
  }

  surface <- min(d$hzdept, na.rm = TRUE)
  first_nonsandy_idx <- which(!d$sandy_hz)[1]

  sandy_mantle_cm <- if (is.na(first_nonsandy_idx)) {
    max(d$hzdepb, na.rm = TRUE) - surface
  } else {
    d$hzdept[first_nonsandy_idx] - surface
  }

  depth_to_first_nonsandy_cm <- if (is.na(first_nonsandy_idx)) NA_real_ else d$hzdept[first_nonsandy_idx]
  sandy_layers_n_surface <- if (is.na(first_nonsandy_idx)) nrow(d) else (first_nonsandy_idx - 1)

  d_int <- d %>%
    mutate(
      ov = overlap_thick(hzdept, hzdepb, interval_top, interval_bot),
      ov_sandy = ifelse(sandy_hz, ov, 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(ov > 0)

  int_thick <- sum(d_int$ov, na.rm = TRUE)
  pct_sandy <- if (int_thick > 0) 100 * sum(d_int$ov_sandy, na.rm = TRUE) / int_thick else NA_real_

  mean_sand <- wmean_safe(d_int$sand, d_int$ov)
  mean_clay <- wmean_safe(d_int$clay, d_int$ov)

  if (!is.na(first_nonsandy_idx) && first_nonsandy_idx > 1) {
    last_sandy <- d[first_nonsandy_idx - 1, ]
    first_non  <- d[first_nonsandy_idx, ]

    has_bt_below_mantle <- isTRUE(first_non$bt_like)
    delta_clay <- first_non$clay - last_sandy$clay
    delta_sand <- last_sandy$sand - first_non$sand

    abrupt <- isTRUE(has_bt_below_mantle) &&
      is.finite(delta_clay) && is.finite(delta_sand) &&
      delta_clay >= 15 && delta_sand >= 20
  } else {
    has_bt_below_mantle <- FALSE
    delta_clay <- NA_real_
    delta_sand <- NA_real_
    abrupt <- FALSE
  }

  tibble(
    sandy_mantle_cm = sandy_mantle_cm,
    depth_to_first_nonsandy_cm = depth_to_first_nonsandy_cm,
    sandy_layers_n_surface = sandy_layers_n_surface,
    pct_sandy_0_150 = pct_sandy,
    mean_sand_0_150 = mean_sand,
    mean_clay_0_150 = mean_clay,
    has_bt_below_mantle = has_bt_below_mantle,
    delta_clay_at_mantle_break = delta_clay,
    delta_sand_at_mantle_break = delta_sand,
    abrupt_sand_to_bt_transition = abrupt
  )
}

overlap_thick <- function(top, bot, a, b) {
  pmax(0, pmin(bot, b) - pmax(top, a))
}

calc_plinthite_indices <- function(df, upper_limit = 150) {

  d <- df %>%
    mutate(
      hzdept = as.numeric(hzdept),
      hzdepb = as.numeric(hzdepb),
      hz_thick = hzdepb - hzdept,

      has_v_suffix = !is.na(L_suffix) & str_detect(str_to_lower(L_suffix), "v"),

      # fallback: horizon name ends with v / has plinthitic-style v code
      has_v_name = is.na(L_suffix) & !is.na(hzname_clean) &
        str_detect(str_to_lower(hzname_clean), "v[0-9]*$|v[a-z]*[0-9]*$"),

      plinthitic_hz = has_v_suffix | has_v_name
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(hzdept), is.finite(hzdepb), hzdepb > hzdept) %>%
    arrange(hzdept, hzdepb)

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      plinthite_flag = NA,
      top_depth_plinthite = NA_real_,
      plinthite_thickness_cm = NA_real_,
      pct_plinthite_by_hz = NA_real_,
      pct_plinthite_by_thickness = NA_real_,
      plinthite_overlap_0_150_cm = NA_real_,
      plinthite_within_150cm_flag = NA
    ))
  }

  profile_top <- min(d$hzdept, na.rm = TRUE)
  profile_bottom <- max(d$hzdepb, na.rm = TRUE)
  profile_thickness <- profile_bottom - profile_top

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      ov_0_150 = overlap_thick(hzdept, hzdepb, 0, upper_limit)
    )

  plinthite_flag <- any(d$plinthitic_hz, na.rm = TRUE)

  top_depth_plinthite <- if (plinthite_flag) {
    min(d$hzdept[d$plinthitic_hz], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  plinthite_thickness_cm <- sum(d$hz_thick[d$plinthitic_hz], na.rm = TRUE)

  pct_plinthite_by_hz <- 100 * mean(d$plinthitic_hz, na.rm = TRUE)

  pct_plinthite_by_thickness <- if (is.finite(profile_thickness) && profile_thickness > 0) {
    100 * plinthite_thickness_cm / profile_thickness
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  plinthite_overlap_0_150_cm <- sum(d$ov_0_150[d$plinthitic_hz], na.rm = TRUE)

  plinthite_within_150cm_flag <- any(d$plinthitic_hz & d$ov_0_150 > 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    plinthite_flag = plinthite_flag,
    top_depth_plinthite = top_depth_plinthite,
    plinthite_thickness_cm = plinthite_thickness_cm,
    pct_plinthite_by_hz = pct_plinthite_by_hz,
    pct_plinthite_by_thickness = pct_plinthite_by_thickness,
    plinthite_overlap_0_150_cm = plinthite_overlap_0_150_cm,
    plinthite_within_150cm_flag = plinthite_within_150cm_flag
  )
}

calc_argillic_kandic_pale_indices <- function(df, upper = 150) {
  d <- df %>%
    mutate(
      hzdept = as.numeric(hzdept),
      hzdepb = as.numeric(hzdepb),
      hz_thick = hzdepb - hzdept,
      has_bt_like = (!is.na(L_suffix) & str_detect(str_to_lower(L_suffix), "t")) |
        (!is.na(hzname_clean) & str_detect(hzname_clean, "^Bt")) |
        (!is.na(hzname) & str_detect(hzname, "^Bt"))
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(hzdept), is.finite(hzdepb), hzdepb > hzdept) %>%
    arrange(hzdept, hzdepb)

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      argillic_kandic_pale_flag = NA,
      depth_to_argillic_kandic_pale_cm = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  argillic_kandic_pale_flag <- any(d$has_bt_like, na.rm = TRUE)

  depth_to_argillic_kandic_pale_cm <- if (argillic_kandic_pale_flag) {
    min(d$hzdept[d$has_bt_like], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  tibble(
    argillic_kandic_pale_flag = argillic_kandic_pale_flag,
    depth_to_argillic_kandic_pale_cm = depth_to_argillic_kandic_pale_cm
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Load data
perry_fp <- read_csv("../data/Perry_FP_data_with_taxa_02_20_2026.csv")
ncss <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))
min_or_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else min(x)
}
# ============================================================
# CLEAN PERRY HORIZON TABLE
# ============================================================

perry_fp_clean <- perry_fp %>%
  mutate(
    Point = as.character(Point),
    Horizon = as.character(Horizon),
    To.Depth..cm. = as.character(To.Depth..cm.),

    taxclname   = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxclname)), ""),
    taxorder    = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxorder)), ""),
    taxsuborder = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxsuborder)), ""),
    taxgrtgroup = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxgrtgroup)), ""),
    taxsubgrp   = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxsubgrp)), ""),
    taxpartsize = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxpartsize)), ""),

    taxpartsize = str_to_lower(taxpartsize)
  ) %>%
  mutate(parsed = purrr::map2(taxsubgrp, taxgrtgroup, parse_subgrp_mods)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(parsed) %>%
  mutate(
    taxgrtgroup = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, subgrp_gg)
  ) %>%
  select(-subgrp_gg)

# ============================================================
# BUILD PERRY PEDON PACK 0-150 CM
# ============================================================

build_perry_pedon_pack_0_150 <- function(perry_fp) {

  hz <- perry_fp %>%
    mutate(
      Point = as.character(Point),
      Horizon = as.character(Horizon),
      To.Depth..cm. = as.character(To.Depth..cm.)
    ) %>%
    bind_cols(parse_top_bottom(.$To.Depth..cm.)) %>%
    mutate(
      bottom_cm = if_else(
        is.na(bottom_cm) & !is.na(top_cm) & !is.na(H.Depth.cm.),
        top_cm + as.numeric(H.Depth.cm.),
        bottom_cm
      ),
      top_cm = as.numeric(top_cm),
      bottom_cm = as.numeric(bottom_cm)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(top_cm), is.finite(bottom_cm), bottom_cm > top_cm) %>%
    group_by(Point) %>%
    tidyr::fill(Horizon, .direction = "down") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      top150 = pmax(top_cm, 0),
      bot150 = pmin(bottom_cm, 150),
      thk150 = pmax(0, bot150 - top150)
    ) %>%
    filter(thk150 > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      hzbase = hz_base(Horizon),
      sand = as.numeric(lab_sand),
      silt = as.numeric(lab_silt),
      clay = as.numeric(lab_clay)
    )

  # ---- FIXED MUNSELL PARSING ----
# ---- FIXED MUNSELL PARSING + RGB CONVERSION ----
    # ---- FIXED MUNSELL PARSING + RGB CONVERSION ----
    m_txt <- fix_munsell(hz$Matrix.Color)
    
    # parse RGB directly from full Munsell notation
    rgb_df <- aqp::parseMunsell(m_txt, return_triplets = TRUE)
    rgb_df <- as.data.frame(rgb_df)
    
    for (nm in c("r", "g", "b")) {
      if (!nm %in% names(rgb_df)) rgb_df[[nm]] <- NA_real_
    }
    
    # get hex directly too
    m_hex <- aqp::parseMunsell(m_txt)
    
    # manually parse hue / value / chroma from cleaned strings
    m_hue <- str_extract(m_txt, "^[A-Z0-9.]+(?=\\s)")
    m_val <- str_extract(m_txt, "(?<=\\s)\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?=/)")
    m_chr <- str_extract(m_txt, "(?<=/)\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?")
    
    hz <- hz %>%
      mutate(
        munsell_fixed = m_txt,
        hue    = m_hue,
        value  = as.numeric(m_val),
        chroma = as.numeric(m_chr),
        hex    = m_hex,
        R      = as.numeric(rgb_df$r),
        G      = as.numeric(rgb_df$g),
        B      = as.numeric(rgb_df$b),
        gley_flag = is_gleyed(Horizon, chroma),
        carb_flag = is_carbonate_hz(Horizon),
        fragipan_flag = str_detect(str_to_lower(Horizon %||% ""), "bx|btx")
      )
  bt_set <- c("Bt","Btg","Btc","Btcb","Btx","Btb","Btv","Btvx","Btcn","Btgb","Btgx","Btgv","Btss","Btvc","Btcv")
  e_set  <- c("E","Eg","EB","BE","Ec","Eb","Ex")

  pedon <- hz %>%
    group_by(Point) %>%
    summarise(
      peiid = first(Point),

      # taxonomy carried forward
      taxclname       = first_non_na(taxclname),
      taxorder        = first_non_na(taxorder),
      taxsuborder     = first_non_na(taxsuborder),
      taxgrtgroup     = first_non_na(taxgrtgroup),
      taxsubgrp       = first_non_na(taxsubgrp),
      taxsubgrp_mod1  = first_non_na(taxsubgrp_mod1),
      taxsubgrp_mod2  = first_non_na(taxsubgrp_mod2),
      taxsubgrp_mod3  = first_non_na(taxsubgrp_mod3),
      taxpartsize     = first_non_na(taxpartsize),

      # SAFE weighted means
      sand_w = wmean_or_na(sand, thk150),
      silt_w = wmean_or_na(silt, thk150),
      clay_w = wmean_or_na(clay, thk150),

      R_w = wmean_or_na(R, thk150),
      G_w = wmean_or_na(G, thk150),
      B_w = wmean_or_na(B, thk150),

      has_Bt_0_150   = any(hzbase %in% bt_set),
      has_E_0_150    = any(hzbase %in% e_set),
      has_gley_0_150 = any(gley_flag, na.rm = TRUE),

      # SAFE mins (no Inf warnings)
      depth_to_Bt_cm   = min_or_na(top150[hzbase %in% bt_set]),
      depth_to_E_cm    = min_or_na(top150[hzbase %in% e_set]),
      depth_to_gley_cm = min_or_na(top150[gley_flag]),

      bt_thk_0_150_cm = sum(thk150[hzbase %in% bt_set], na.rm = TRUE),

      has_argillic_0_150    = any(hzbase %in% bt_set),
      depth_to_argillic_cm  = min_or_na(top150[hzbase %in% bt_set]),
      argillic_thk_0_150_cm = sum(thk150[hzbase %in% bt_set], na.rm = TRUE),

      any_argillic  = any(hzbase %in% bt_set),
      any_gleyed    = any(gley_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
      any_fragipan  = any(fragipan_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
      any_carbonate = any(carb_flag, na.rm = TRUE),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  hz_levels <- c(
    "A","Ap","Ab","Ag","E","Eg","Ex","B","Bc","Bh","Bt","Btg","Btgx","Btss","BC",
    "C","Cg","Oa","Oe","R","Unknown"
  )

    prop <- hz %>%
    mutate(hzbase = factor(hzbase, levels = hz_levels)) %>%
    group_by(Point, hzbase) %>%
    summarise(thk = sum(thk150, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Point) %>%
    mutate(
      total_thk = sum(thk, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop = dplyr::if_else(total_thk > 0, thk / total_thk, 0)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Point, hzbase, prop) %>%
    tidyr::complete(Point, hzbase, fill = list(prop = 0)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = hzbase, values_from = prop, names_prefix = "prop_hzbase_")

  pedon %>%
    left_join(prop, by = c("peiid" = "Point")) %>%
    select(-Point) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double))
}

# ============================================================
# REBUILD PERRY PACK
# ============================================================
perry_fp_clean <- perry_fp %>%
  mutate(
    Point = as.character(Point),
    Horizon = as.character(Horizon),
    To.Depth..cm. = as.character(To.Depth..cm.),

    taxclname   = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxclname)), ""),
    taxorder    = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxorder)), ""),
    taxsuborder = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxsuborder)), ""),
    taxgrtgroup = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxgrtgroup)), ""),
    taxsubgrp   = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxsubgrp)), ""),
    taxpartsize = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxpartsize)), ""),

    taxpartsize = str_to_lower(taxpartsize)
  ) %>%
  mutate(parsed = purrr::map2(taxsubgrp, taxgrtgroup, parse_subgrp_mods)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(parsed) %>%
  mutate(
    taxgrtgroup = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, subgrp_gg)
  ) %>%
  select(-subgrp_gg)
# --- Perry horizon table in NCSS-like schema ---
perry_hz_for_indices <- perry_fp_clean %>%
  bind_cols(parse_top_bottom(.$To.Depth..cm.)) %>%
  mutate(

      str_detect(str_to_lower(Horizon), "^bg")  ~ "g",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(Horizon), "^ap")  ~ "p",

    ),

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x
}

add_top1_margin <- function(pred_df) {
  pred_cols <- names(pred_df)[
    stringr::str_detect(names(pred_df), "^\\.pred_") & names(pred_df) != ".pred_class"
  ]

  pred_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      probs  = list(c_across(all_of(pred_cols))),
      top1   = max(probs, na.rm = TRUE),
      top2   = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, sort(probs, decreasing = TRUE)[2], NA_real_),
      margin = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, top1 - top2, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-probs)
}

pad_like_train_raw <- function(new_df, train_df, outcome) {
  req <- setdiff(names(train_df), outcome)
  out <- new_df

  missing <- setdiff(req, names(out))

  for (nm in missing) {
    tmpl <- train_df[[nm]]

    if (stringr::str_detect(nm, "^prop_hzbase_")) {
      out[[nm]] <- 0
    } else if (stringr::str_detect(nm, "^(any_|has_)")) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.logical(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.numeric(tmpl) || is.integer(tmpl) || is.double(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_real_
    } else {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_character_
    }
  }

  out %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, FALSE))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double)) %>%
    select(any_of(c("peiid", req)))
}

deploy_plain_to_perry <- function(bundle, perry_pack) {
  outcome <- bundle$outcome

  perry_raw <- pad_like_train_raw(
    new_df = perry_pack,
    train_df = bundle$train_raw,
    outcome = outcome
  )

  x_perry <- bake(bundle$prep_rec, new_data = perry_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric))

  missing_baked <- setdiff(bundle$x_cols, names(x_perry))
  if (length(missing_baked) > 0) {
    stop("Missing baked columns in Perry for ", bundle$name, ": ",
         paste(missing_baked, collapse = ", "))
  }

  x_perry <- x_perry %>%
    select(all_of(bundle$x_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, 0)))

  pred <- bind_cols(
    perry_raw %>% select(peiid),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = x_perry, type = "prob"),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = x_perry, type = "class")
  ) %>%
    add_top1_margin() %>%
    mutate(
      model_name = bundle$name,
      outcome = bundle$outcome,
      model_type = bundle$model_type
    )

  pred
}

deploy_umap_hdb_to_perry <- function(bundle, perry_pack) {
  outcome <- bundle$outcome

  perry_raw <- pad_like_train_raw(
    new_df = perry_pack,
    train_df = bundle$train_raw,
    outcome = outcome
  )

  x_perry <- bake(bundle$prep_rec, new_data = perry_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric))

  missing_baked <- setdiff(bundle$x_cols, names(x_perry))
  if (length(missing_baked) > 0) {
    stop("Missing baked columns in Perry for ", bundle$name, ": ",
         paste(missing_baked, collapse = ", "))
  }

  x_perry <- x_perry %>%
    select(all_of(bundle$x_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, 0)))
# UMAP transform
  if (is.null(bundle$umap_fit)) {
    stop("bundle$umap_fit is NULL for ", bundle$name)
  }
  
  z_perry <- as.data.frame(
    uwot::umap_transform(
      X = as.matrix(x_perry),
      model = bundle$umap_fit
    )
  )
  names(z_perry) <- bundle$umap_colnames

  train_z <- bundle$train_umap_features
  train_cluster <- bundle$hdb_fit$cluster

  nearest_idx <- apply(as.matrix(z_perry), 1, function(z) {
    d <- rowSums((train_z - matrix(z, nrow = nrow(train_z), ncol = ncol(train_z), byrow = TRUE))^2)
    which.min(d)
  })

  perry_cluster <- train_cluster[nearest_idx]
  hdb_levels <- sort(unique(train_cluster))

  perry_model_dat <- bind_cols(
    z_perry,
    hdb_cluster = factor(perry_cluster, levels = hdb_levels),
    hdb_noise = factor(if_else(perry_cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                       levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
  )

  pred <- bind_cols(
    perry_raw %>% select(peiid),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = perry_model_dat, type = "prob"),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = perry_model_dat, type = "class")
  ) %>%
    add_top1_margin() %>%
    mutate(
      model_name = bundle$name,
      outcome = bundle$outcome,
      model_type = bundle$model_type
    )

  pred
}

deploy_bundle_to_perry <- function(bundle, perry_pack) {
  if (bundle$model_type == "plain") {
    deploy_plain_to_perry(bundle, perry_pack)
  } else if (bundle$model_type == "umap_hdb") {
    deploy_umap_hdb_to_perry(bundle, perry_pack)
  } else {
    stop("Unknown model_type: ", bundle$model_type)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Pad new raw data to match training raw columns
# -------------------------------
pad_like_train_raw <- function(new_df, train_df, outcome) {
  req <- setdiff(names(train_df), outcome)
  out <- new_df

  missing <- setdiff(req, names(out))

  for (nm in missing) {
    tmpl <- train_df[[nm]]

    if (str_detect(nm, "^prop_hzbase_")) {
      out[[nm]] <- 0
    } else if (str_detect(nm, "^(any_|has_)")) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.logical(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.numeric(tmpl) || is.integer(tmpl) || is.double(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_real_
    } else {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_character_
    }
  }

  out %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double)) %>%
    select(any_of(c("peiid", req)))
}
coerce_raw_types_like_train <- function(new_df, train_df, outcome) {
  req <- setdiff(names(train_df), outcome)
  out <- new_df

  common <- intersect(req, names(out))

  for (nm in common) {
    tmpl <- train_df[[nm]]

    if (is.integer(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- as.integer(round(as.numeric(out[[nm]])))
    } else if (is.double(tmpl) || is.numeric(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- as.numeric(out[[nm]])
    } else if (is.logical(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- as.logical(out[[nm]])
      out[[nm]][is.na(out[[nm]])] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.character(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- as.character(out[[nm]])
    } else if (is.factor(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- factor(as.character(out[[nm]]), levels = levels(tmpl))
    }
  }

  out
}
# -------------------------------
# Fit one UMAP + RF model
# -------------------------------
fit_umap_rf_workflow <- function(
  ncss_df,
  outcome,
  min_n = NULL,
  filter_expr = NULL,
  seed_split = 101,
  seed_umap = 202,
  k_umap = 10,
  n_neighbors = 15
) {
  outcome <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(outcome))
  outcome_sym <- rlang::sym(outcome)

  if (!outcome %in% names(ncss_df)) {
    stop("Outcome column not found in ncss_df: ", outcome)
  }

  tax_cols <- c(
    "taxonname_clean", "taxonname_key", "taxclname",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup", "taxsubgrp",
    "taxsubgrp_mod1", "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3",
    "taxpartsize", "taxmineralogy", "taxactivity", "taxtemp"
  )

  dat <- ncss_df %>%
    mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))
  dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), ~ replace_na(.x, FALSE)))

  if (!is.null(filter_expr)) {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(!!rlang::parse_expr(filter_expr))
  }

  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      !!outcome_sym := str_squish(as.character(.data[[outcome]])),
      !!outcome_sym := na_if(.data[[outcome]], "")
    )

  if (outcome == "taxpartsize") {
    dat <- dat %>%
      mutate(!!outcome_sym := str_to_lower(.data[[outcome]]))
  }

  dat <- dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome]]))

  if (!is.null(min_n)) {
    dat <- dat %>%
      mutate(
        !!outcome_sym := fct_lump_min(
          factor(.data[[outcome]]),
          min = min_n,
          other_level = "Other"
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(.data[[outcome]] != "Other") %>%
      droplevels()
  } else {
    dat <- dat %>%
      mutate(!!outcome_sym := factor(.data[[outcome]])) %>%
      droplevels()
  }

  if (nlevels(dat[[outcome]]) < 2) {
    stop("Need at least 2 classes after filtering/lumping for outcome: ", outcome)
  }

  dat <- dat %>% mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double))

  set.seed(seed_split)
  split <- initial_split(dat, prop = 0.8, strata = !!outcome_sym)
  train <- training(split)
  test  <- testing(split)

  # remove taxonomy leaks EXCEPT the outcome itself
  drop_cols <- setdiff(tax_cols, outcome)

  # also drop leftover character predictors not id/outcome
  char_drop <- names(train)[vapply(train, is.character, logical(1))]
  char_drop <- setdiff(char_drop, c("peiid", outcome))
  drop_cols <- union(drop_cols, char_drop)

  train <- train %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))
  test  <- test  %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))

  rec <- recipe(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ .")), data = train) %>%
    update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
    step_mutate_at(all_nominal_predictors(), fn = as.factor) %>%
    step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.01) %>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

  prep_rec <- prep(rec)

  b_train <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train)
  b_test  <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = test)

  x_train <- b_train %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric))
  
  x_test <- b_test %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric))
  
  # drop columns that are completely missing in training
  all_na_cols <- names(x_train)[vapply(x_train, function(x) all(is.na(x)), logical(1))]
  if (length(all_na_cols) > 0) {
    message("Dropping all-NA baked columns: ", paste(all_na_cols, collapse = ", "))
    x_train <- x_train %>% select(-all_of(all_na_cols))
    x_test  <- x_test  %>% select(-all_of(all_na_cols))
  }
  
  # align test to train columns
  x_cols <- names(x_train)
  x_test <- x_test %>% select(all_of(x_cols))
  
  # replace any remaining NA / Inf / -Inf
  x_train <- x_train %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, 0)))
  
  x_test <- x_test %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, 0)))
  
  stopifnot(!anyNA(x_train))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(x_test))

  set.seed(seed_umap)
  umap_fit <- uwot::umap(
    X = as.matrix(x_train),
    n_components = k_umap,
    n_neighbors = max(2, min(n_neighbors, nrow(x_train) - 1)),
    min_dist = 0.1,
    metric = "euclidean",
    ret_model = TRUE
  )

  z_train <- as.data.frame(umap_fit$embedding)
  names(z_train) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train)))

  z_test <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test), umap_fit))
  names(z_test) <- names(z_train)

  train_umap <- bind_cols(z_train, !!outcome_sym := train[[outcome]])
  test_umap  <- bind_cols(z_test,  !!outcome_sym := test[[outcome]])

  rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 1000) %>%
    set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
    set_mode("classification")

  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(rf_spec) %>%
    add_formula(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ .")))

  rf_fit <- fit(wf, data = train_umap)

  pred_test <- bind_cols(
    predict(rf_fit, test_umap, type = "prob"),
    predict(rf_fit, test_umap, type = "class"),
    test_umap %>% select(all_of(outcome))
  ) %>%
    add_top1_margin()

  list(
    outcome = outcome,
    outcome_levels = levels(train[[outcome]]),
    train_raw = train,
    test_raw = test,
    prep_rec = prep_rec,
    x_cols = x_cols,
    umap_fit = umap_fit,
    rf_fit = rf_fit,
    train_umap = train_umap,
    test_umap = test_umap,
    pred_test = pred_test
  )
}

# -------------------------------
# Predict Perry with fitted workflow
# -------------------------------
predict_on_perry <- function(model_obj, perry_pack) {
  outcome <- model_obj$outcome

  perry_ready_raw <- pad_like_train_raw(
    new_df = perry_pack,
    train_df = model_obj$train_raw,
    outcome = outcome
  )
  perry_ready_raw <- perry_ready_raw %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), ~ replace_na(.x, FALSE)))

  x_perry <- bake(model_obj$prep_rec, new_data = perry_ready_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric))

  # hard-align Perry baked columns to training baked columns
  x_perry <- x_perry %>% select(all_of(model_obj$x_cols))

  z_perry <- as.data.frame(
    uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_perry), model_obj$umap_fit)
  )
  names(z_perry) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_perry)))

  perry_umap <- bind_cols(
    perry_ready_raw %>% select(peiid),
    z_perry
  )

  pred <- bind_cols(
    perry_umap %>% select(peiid),
    predict(model_obj$rf_fit, perry_umap, type = "prob"),
    predict(model_obj$rf_fit, perry_umap, type = "class")
  ) %>%
    add_top1_margin()

  pred
}

# -------------------------------
# Build pedon truth from Perry horizon table
# -------------------------------
build_perry_truth <- function(perry_fp_clean, truth_col, order_filter = NULL) {
  truth_col <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(truth_col))

  dat <- perry_fp_clean %>%
    mutate(
      peiid = as.character(Point),
      truth_val = na_if(str_squish(as.character(.data[[truth_col]])), "")
    )

  if (truth_col == "taxpartsize") {
    dat <- dat %>% mutate(truth_val = str_to_lower(truth_val))
  }

  if (!is.null(order_filter)) {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(taxorder == order_filter)
  }

  dat %>%
    group_by(peiid) %>%
    summarise(
      n_hz = n(),
      n_truth_nonNA = sum(!is.na(truth_val)),
      n_truth_unique = n_distinct(truth_val[!is.na(truth_val)]),
      truth = mode_non_na(truth_val),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# -------------------------------
# Validate Perry predictions
# -------------------------------
validate_perry_preds <- function(pred_df, truth_df) {
  out <- pred_df %>%
    left_join(truth_df, by = "peiid") %>%
    filter(!is.na(truth), n_truth_unique == 1) %>%
    mutate(
      truth = factor(truth),
      .pred_class = factor(as.character(.pred_class))
    )

  lvl <- union(levels(out$truth), levels(out$.pred_class))

  out <- out %>%
    mutate(
      truth = factor(truth, levels = lvl),
      .pred_class = factor(.pred_class, levels = lvl)
    )

  list(
    data = out,
    conf_mat = conf_mat(out, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class),
    metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(out, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class),
    f_meas = f_meas(out, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro")
  )
}
```

```{r}
  )
}

pad_like_train_raw <- function(new_df, train_df, outcome) {
  req <- setdiff(names(train_df), outcome)
  out <- new_df

  missing <- setdiff(req, names(out))

  for (nm in missing) {
    tmpl <- train_df[[nm]]

    if (str_detect(nm, "^prop_hzbase_")) {
      out[[nm]] <- 0
    } else if (str_detect(nm, "^(any_|has_)")) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.logical(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.numeric(tmpl) || is.integer(tmpl) || is.double(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_real_
    } else {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_character_
    }
  }

  out %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, FALSE))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double)) %>%
    select(any_of(c("peiid", req)))
}
```

```{r}
deploy_plain_to_perry <- function(bundle, perry_pack) {
  stopifnot(bundle$model_type == "plain")

  outcome <- bundle$outcome

  perry_raw <- pad_like_train_raw(
  new_df = perry_pack,
  train_df = bundle$train_raw,
  outcome = outcome)

  perry_raw <- coerce_raw_types_like_train(
    new_df = perry_raw,
    train_df = bundle$train_raw,
    outcome = outcome)
  x_perry <- bake(bundle$prep_rec, new_data = perry_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    select(all_of(bundle$x_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, 0)))

  pred <- bind_cols(
    perry_raw %>% select(peiid),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = bind_cols(x_perry), type = "prob"),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = bind_cols(x_perry), type = "class")
  ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      probs = list(c_across(starts_with(".pred_") & !matches("^\\.pred_class$"))),
      top1 = max(probs),
      top2 = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, sort(probs, decreasing = TRUE)[2], NA_real_),
      margin = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, top1 - top2, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  pred
}
```

```{r}
deploy_umap_hdb_to_perry <- function(bundle, perry_pack) {
  stopifnot(bundle$model_type == "umap_hdb")

  outcome <- bundle$outcome

  if (is.null(bundle$umap_fit)) {
    stop("bundle$umap_fit is NULL for ", bundle$name)
  }
  if (is.null(bundle$hdb_fit)) {
    stop("bundle$hdb_fit is NULL for ", bundle$name)
  }
  if (is.null(bundle$train_umap_features)) {
    stop("bundle$train_umap_features is NULL for ", bundle$name)
  }

  perry_raw <- pad_like_train_raw(
    new_df = perry_pack,
    train_df = bundle$train_raw,
    outcome = outcome
  )
  
  perry_raw <- coerce_raw_types_like_train(
    new_df = perry_raw,
    train_df = bundle$train_raw,
    outcome = outcome
  )

  x_perry <- bake(bundle$prep_rec, new_data = perry_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric))

  missing_baked <- setdiff(bundle$x_cols, names(x_perry))
  if (length(missing_baked) > 0) {
    stop("Missing baked columns in Perry for ", bundle$name, ": ",
         paste(missing_baked, collapse = ", "))
  }

  x_perry <- x_perry %>%
    select(all_of(bundle$x_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, 0)))

  z_perry <- as.data.frame(
    uwot::umap_transform(X = as.matrix(x_perry), model = bundle$umap_fit)
  )
  names(z_perry) <- bundle$umap_colnames

  train_z <- bundle$train_umap_features
  train_cluster <- bundle$hdb_fit$cluster

  nearest_idx <- apply(as.matrix(z_perry), 1, function(z) {
    d <- rowSums((train_z - matrix(z, nrow = nrow(train_z), ncol = ncol(train_z), byrow = TRUE))^2)
    which.min(d)
  })

  perry_cluster <- train_cluster[nearest_idx]
  hdb_levels <- sort(unique(train_cluster))

  perry_model_dat <- bind_cols(
    z_perry,
    hdb_cluster = factor(perry_cluster, levels = hdb_levels),
    hdb_noise = factor(if_else(perry_cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                       levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
  )

  pred <- bind_cols(
    perry_raw %>% select(peiid),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = perry_model_dat, type = "prob"),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = perry_model_dat, type = "class")
  ) %>%
    add_top1_margin() %>%
    mutate(
      model_name = bundle$name,
      outcome = bundle$outcome,
      model_type = bundle$model_type
    )

  pred
}
```

```{r}
add_hdbscan_features <- function(train_umap, test_umap, outcome, minPts = 10) {

  x_train <- train_umap %>% select(-all_of(outcome))
  x_test  <- test_umap  %>% select(-all_of(outcome))

  hdb_fit <- dbscan::hdbscan(
    as.matrix(x_train),
    minPts = minPts
  )

  # store training coords for later Perry prediction
  hdb_fit$data <- as.matrix(x_train)

  test_cluster <- predict(
    hdb_fit,
    newdata = as.matrix(x_test),
    data    = as.matrix(x_train)
  )

  levs <- sort(unique(c(hdb_fit$cluster, test_cluster)))

  train_hdb <- train_umap %>%
    mutate(
      hdb_cluster = factor(hdb_fit$cluster, levels = levs),
      hdb_noise   = factor(if_else(hdb_fit$cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                           levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
    )

  test_hdb <- test_umap %>%
    mutate(
      hdb_cluster = factor(test_cluster, levels = levs),
      hdb_noise   = factor(if_else(test_cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                           levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
    )

  list(
    train = train_hdb,
    test  = test_hdb,
    fit   = hdb_fit
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# PERRY DEPLOYMENT BUNDLE + PREDICTION RUNNER
# Assumes:
#   - perry_pack_150 exists
#   - the NCSS model objects from your training script still exist
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(uwot)
library(dbscan)
library(rlang)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ------------------------------------------------------------
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x

add_top1_margin <- function(pred_df) {
  pred_cols <- names(pred_df)[
    str_detect(names(pred_df), "^\\.pred_") & names(pred_df) != ".pred_class"
  ]

  pred_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      probs  = list(c_across(all_of(pred_cols))),
      top1   = max(probs, na.rm = TRUE),
      top2   = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, sort(probs, decreasing = TRUE)[2], NA_real_),
      margin = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, top1 - top2, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-probs)
}

pad_like_train_raw <- function(new_df, train_df, outcome) {
  req <- setdiff(names(train_df), outcome)
  out <- new_df

  missing <- setdiff(req, names(out))

  for (nm in missing) {
    tmpl <- train_df[[nm]]

    if (str_detect(nm, "^prop_hzbase_")) {
      out[[nm]] <- 0
    } else if (str_detect(nm, "^(any_|has_)")) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.logical(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    } else if (is.numeric(tmpl) || is.integer(tmpl) || is.double(tmpl)) {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_real_
    } else {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_character_
    }
  }

  out %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, FALSE))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.integer), as.double)) %>%
    select(any_of(c("peiid", req)))
}

# build truth from Perry horizon table
mode_non_na <- function(x) {
  y <- x[!is.na(x) & str_squish(as.character(x)) != ""]
  if (length(y) == 0) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(y), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

build_perry_truth <- function(perry_fp_clean, truth_col, order_filter = NULL) {
  truth_col <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(truth_col))

  dat <- perry_fp_clean %>%
    mutate(
      peiid = as.character(Point),
      truth_val = na_if(str_squish(as.character(.data[[truth_col]])), "")
    )

  if (truth_col == "taxpartsize") {
    dat <- dat %>% mutate(truth_val = str_to_lower(truth_val))
  }

  if (!is.null(order_filter)) {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(taxorder == order_filter)
  }

  dat %>%
    group_by(peiid) %>%
    summarise(
      n_hz = n(),
      n_truth_nonNA = sum(!is.na(truth_val)),
      n_truth_unique = n_distinct(truth_val[!is.na(truth_val)]),
      truth = mode_non_na(truth_val),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

validate_perry_preds <- function(pred_df, truth_df) {
  out <- pred_df %>%
    left_join(truth_df, by = "peiid") %>%
    filter(!is.na(truth), n_truth_unique == 1) %>%
    mutate(
      truth = factor(truth),
      .pred_class = factor(as.character(.pred_class))
    )

  lvl <- union(levels(out$truth), levels(out$.pred_class))

  out <- out %>%
    mutate(
      truth = factor(truth, levels = lvl),
      .pred_class = factor(.pred_class, levels = lvl)
    )

  list(
    data = out,
    conf_mat = conf_mat(out, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class),
    metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(out, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class),
    f_meas = f_meas(out, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro")
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Bundle constructors
# ------------------------------------------------------------
make_plain_bundle <- function(
  name,
  outcome,
  train_raw,
  prep_rec,
  fit_obj
) {
  x_cols <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    names()

  list(
    name = name,
    model_type = "plain",
    outcome = outcome,
    train_raw = train_raw,
    prep_rec = prep_rec,
    x_cols = x_cols,
    fit = fit_obj
  )
}

make_umap_hdb_bundle <- function(
  name,
  outcome,
  train_raw,
  prep_rec,
  umap_fit,
  hdb_fit,
  fit_obj,
  train_umap_features
) {
  x_cols <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    names()

  umap_colnames <- colnames(train_umap_features)

  list(
    name = name,
    model_type = "umap_hdb",
    outcome = outcome,
    train_raw = train_raw,
    prep_rec = prep_rec,
    x_cols = x_cols,
    umap_fit = umap_fit,
    hdb_fit = hdb_fit,
    fit = fit_obj,
    umap_colnames = umap_colnames,
    train_umap_features = as.matrix(train_umap_features)
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Deployment functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------
deploy_plain_to_perry <- function(bundle, perry_pack) {
  stopifnot(bundle$model_type == "plain")

  outcome <- bundle$outcome

  perry_raw <- pad_like_train_raw(
    new_df = perry_pack,
    train_df = bundle$train_raw,
    outcome = outcome
  )

  x_perry <- bake(bundle$prep_rec, new_data = perry_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric))

  missing_baked <- setdiff(bundle$x_cols, names(x_perry))
  if (length(missing_baked) > 0) {
    stop("Missing baked columns in Perry for ", bundle$name, ": ",
         paste(missing_baked, collapse = ", "))
  }

  x_perry <- x_perry %>%
    select(all_of(bundle$x_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, 0)))

  pred <- bind_cols(
    perry_raw %>% select(peiid),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = x_perry, type = "prob"),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = x_perry, type = "class")
  ) %>%
    add_top1_margin() %>%
    mutate(
      model_name = bundle$name,
      outcome = bundle$outcome,
      model_type = bundle$model_type
    )

  pred
}

deploy_umap_hdb_to_perry <- function(bundle, perry_pack) {
  stopifnot(bundle$model_type == "umap_hdb")

  if (is.null(bundle$umap_fit)) {
    stop("bundle$umap_fit is NULL for ", bundle$name)
  }

  outcome <- bundle$outcome

  perry_raw <- pad_like_train_raw(
    new_df = perry_pack,
    train_df = bundle$train_raw,
    outcome = outcome
  )

  x_perry <- bake(bundle$prep_rec, new_data = perry_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric))

  missing_baked <- setdiff(bundle$x_cols, names(x_perry))
  if (length(missing_baked) > 0) {
    stop("Missing baked columns in Perry for ", bundle$name, ": ",
         paste(missing_baked, collapse = ", "))
  }

  x_perry <- x_perry %>%
    select(all_of(bundle$x_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, 0)))

  z_perry <- as.data.frame(
    uwot::umap_transform(X = as.matrix(x_perry), model = bundle$umap_fit)
  )
  names(z_perry) <- bundle$umap_colnames

  train_z <- bundle$train_umap_features
  train_cluster <- bundle$hdb_fit$cluster

  nearest_idx <- apply(as.matrix(z_perry), 1, function(z) {
    d <- rowSums((train_z - matrix(z, nrow = nrow(train_z), ncol = ncol(train_z), byrow = TRUE))^2)
    which.min(d)
  })

  perry_cluster <- train_cluster[nearest_idx]
  hdb_levels <- sort(unique(train_cluster))

  perry_model_dat <- bind_cols(
    z_perry,
    hdb_cluster = factor(perry_cluster, levels = hdb_levels),
    hdb_noise = factor(if_else(perry_cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                       levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
  )

  pred <- bind_cols(
    perry_raw %>% select(peiid),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = perry_model_dat, type = "prob"),
    predict(bundle$final_fit, new_data = perry_model_dat, type = "class")
  ) %>%
    add_top1_margin() %>%
    mutate(
      model_name = bundle$name,
      outcome = bundle$outcome,
      model_type = bundle$model_type
    )

  pred
}

deploy_bundle_to_perry <- function(bundle, perry_pack) {
  if (bundle$model_type == "plain") {
    deploy_plain_to_perry(bundle, perry_pack)
  } else if (bundle$model_type == "umap_hdb") {
    deploy_umap_hdb_to_perry(bundle, perry_pack)
  } else {
    stop("Unknown model_type: ", bundle$model_type)
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Refresh UMAP models if uwot transform is broken
# ------------------------------------------------------------
refresh_umap_bundle <- function(bundle, outcome, n_components, n_neighbors, seed_umap = 2) {
  x_train_rebuilt <- bake(bundle$prep_rec, new_data = bundle$train_raw) %>%
    select(-any_of(c(outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    select(all_of(bundle$x_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, 0)))

  set.seed(seed_umap)
  umap_fit_rebuilt <- uwot::umap(
    as.matrix(x_train_rebuilt),
    n_components = n_components,
    n_neighbors = min(n_neighbors, nrow(x_train_rebuilt) - 1),
    min_dist = 0.1,
    metric = "euclidean",
    ret_model = TRUE
  )

  bundle$umap_fit <- umap_fit_rebuilt
  bundle$train_umap_features <- umap_fit_rebuilt$embedding
  bundle$umap_colnames <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(umap_fit_rebuilt$embedding)))

  bundle
}

# taxorder UMAP refresh

    outcome = "taxorder",
    n_components = 10,
    n_neighbors = 15,
    seed_umap = 2

# great group UMAP refresh

    outcome = "taxgrtgroup",
    n_components = 15,
    n_neighbors = 10,
    seed_umap = 140
  )
}
```
